blocks.text: Refresh your living space with the sleek, minimalist look of this modern sofa couch. The soft velvet fabric comes in an inviting color that brightens up any room. Sink into the plush cushions and relax in comfort with the extra deep seating and high-resilience foam. Sturdy solid wood frame construction ensures this small sofa will be a long-lasting focal point in your home.

items: Modern Style Sofa - This living room sofa will provide a fresh and inviting look to your space and will be the center of attention thanks to its sleek design, minimalist silhouette, pleasing color, and plush seating.

Ideal Comfort - This modern couch is made of high-quality velvet fabric which can be easily cleaned with a wet cloth, bringing effortless style to brighten up living rooms, dens, or home offices with its extra deep seating. Sit back, relax and enjoy.

Built to Last - Combining high-resilience foam and premium craftsmanship, this small sofa sectionals for living room will provide you with sink-in comfort for hours of lounging, reading, or working from home. Solid wood frame construction means years of worry-free usage.

Overall Dimensions - Dimensions of W94.5 x D40.2 x H26.8 with a weight capacity of up to 440lbs making it perfect for seating 3-4 people. Two square textured throw pillows in complementary tones enhance the stylish yet homey aesthetic.
Easy Clean & Assemble - Low maintenance design means occasional vacuuming or spot cleaning is all that's needed to preserve the crisp, fresh look.
